en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, 
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> narrated to me that

his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>, there was in his<sup>asws</sup> presence a woman from the Kharijites, I believe he<sup>asws</sup> said from the Clan of Haneefa. So a slave of his<sup>asws</sup> said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘O son<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! In your<sup>asws</sup> presence is a woman who disavows from your<sup>asws</sup> grandfather<sup>saww</sup>’. So my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> judged that he<sup>asws</sup> divorces her’.

So she claimed for her dower upon him. So she went over with him<sup>asws</sup> to the Emir of Al-Medina claiming it. So the Emir of Al-Medina said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘O Ali (Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>)! But, you<sup>asws</sup> either swear an oath or you<sup>asws</sup> giver her, her right’.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me<sup>asws</sup>: ‘Arise, O my<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>, so give her four hundred Dinars’. So I<sup>asws</sup> said to him<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O Father<sup>asws</sup>! May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! Are you<sup>asws</sup> not rightful?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, my<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>! But, I<sup>asws</sup> delayed the swearing of an oath by Allah<sup>azwj</sup> patiently’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir who has narrated the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once spoke to me about his father, ‘Alayhi al-Salam.

He (the Imam) was with a woman of al-Khawarij, I (the narrator) think he said, ‘banu Hanifah.’ His mawla (friend or servant) said to him (the Imam), ‘O child of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, you have a woman who denounces your grandfather.’ (Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said) ‘My father divorced her.

She presented a claim for her mahr (dower) against him (the Imam) and brought him (the Imam) before the Amir (governor) of al-Madinah who asked him (the Imam), “O Ali, you must take an oath or pay her right.”

He (the Imam) asked me to go and bring four hundred dinars. I then asked, “Father, I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, were you not the rightful party?” He (the Imam) replied, “Yes, son but I because of the Glory of Allah did not want to swear by Allah which is made binding upon me.’””
